▎ Auto mode is now Claude Code's default permission mode.
▎ Auto mode lets Claude handle permission prompts automatically. Claude checks each tool call for risky actions and prompt injection before executing, runs the
▎ ones it assesses as lower-risk, and blocks the rest.
▎ https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes
